citation.authors: Callender VD, Alexis AF, Bhatia N, Harper JC et al
citation.journal: Journal of Clinical and Aesthetic Dermatology

record.population: 156 Black participants (14% of 1,115) pooled from four industry trials in acne
record.design: Post hoc subgroup analysis of a clindamycin, adapalene and benzoyl peroxide triple gel against vehicle, 12 weeks
record.finding: Acne treatment success was 32.0% against 18.3% on vehicle (P=0.07). Inflammatory and noninflammatory lesions fell more with the gel, and hyperpigmentation scores stayed at or below baseline. The authors state the studies were not powered for Black participants, so P values are informative only.
record.note: Industry-sponsored trials (the gel is a branded product), post hoc subgroup, hyperpigmentation was a safety score, not the main outcome. Treats acne, not marks.
